title: Absorbing a Polynomial Exponent
statement: For all natural numbers $K,k$, there exist natural numbers $A,e$ such that for every natural number $n$, $2^{K(n+1)^k}\le A\cdot 2^{n^e}$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $K$ and $k$ there exist constants $A$ and $e$ such that $2^{K(n+1)^k} \le A \cdot 2^{n^e}$ for every natural number $n$.
